substitutions.notes: uppercase code, e.g. EN; unsupported values fail ComfyUI prompt validation
uploaded input path relative to the ComfyUI input directory

release_after_run_note: release_after_run=false retains the model between narration chunks; Studio releases it once after the narration job when unload_after is enabled.

safety.notes: The central checkpoint is passed through custom_model_path; no weights are downloaded or duplicated. acceleration_mode and use_cuda_kernel stay off for reproducibility.
